visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two adult males sit side-by-side in a modern studio environment. The man on the left has short black hair and wears a black t-shirt, gesturing with his right hand as he speaks. The man on the right, also in a black t-shirt, listens attentively. They are positioned behind a table covered with light green protective mats, on which calligraphy brushes and ink are placed. The background is a grey concrete-textured wall featuring the logo 'THE DODO MEN'. (2) The scene transitions to the men actively using calligraphy brushes to write Chinese characters on white paper sheets. The camera captures close-up shots of their hands and facial expressions of concentration and amusement. Occasional variety-show style text overlays and brackets appear around their heads. (3) The man on the right holds up a large green folder with the Chinese character '緣' (Yuan) written in black ink. A rapid sequence of video thumbnails from past projects overlays the screen, showing various urban and outdoor settings. (4) The man on the left holds up his chosen character '生' (Sheng) on a green folder. A montage of diverse still photos and short clips replaces the main view, depicting activities like cycling in professional gear, sitting by a campfire at night, and standing on a beach. (5) The final phase features a dense grid montage composed of dozens of small rectangular photos. These images depict travels, group gatherings, and diverse landscapes. A centered text overlay appears with the year '2026' and an English slogan.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Two male voices engage in a rapid, high-energy dialogue with frequent laughter and rising intonation. The BGM is a bright, acoustic folk-pop track with prominent guitar strumming and a steady percussion beat at ~124 BPM. (2) A synthetic 'Whoosh' sound effect triggers as the scene cuts, followed by a light 'Pop' sound. The voices continue in an excited, teasing tone. (3) The vocal intensity increases as the speakers transition from conversational chat to direct-to-audience address. BGM remains constant in the background. (4) The BGM shifts slightly in texture during the montage, adding more synthesized layers to increase the energy. The voices speak about growth and connection with high arousal. (5) The final phase features a transition to a more energetic electronic build-up with a strong, driving beat. Speech ceases entirely, leaving only the upbeat, festive music to conclude the track.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Introduction -> Reveal Part 1 -> Reveal Part 2 -> Closing Wishes.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a year-end reflection and New Year's greeting. The creators use a traditional calligraphy challenge to reveal their personal 'words of the year' for 2025 ('緣' and '生'), connecting these themes to their previous content and expressing gratitude and encouragement to their audience for 2026.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes a split-narrative format, shifting from a focused studio discussion to a high-speed highlight montage, characteristic of social-media native short-form content.
